variant_decisions.evidence: Qere וְרָהְגָּה and ketiv ורוהגה differ only by a plene waw inside the name; both transliterate as 'and Rohgah', which is what ASV prints. The 'other' note (Shomer, v. 32) concerns a different name. Base qere projection retained.

ASV 'Jehubbah' renders the ketiv יחבה with initial yod and no conjunction ('Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram' — no 'and' before the name); the qere וְחֻבָּה would yield 'and Hubbah'. The 'other' note (Shomer, v. 32) concerns a different name.
